display.purpose: Primary page title and brand mark only. Uses the ff-title gradient exception.

heading.purpose: Section headings and panel titles. ff-heading class.

label.purpose: Field labels, column headers, nav links, section markers. ff-label class.

body.purpose: Prose, descriptions, helper text. Invisible voice — max 65–75ch.

mono.purpose: All numeric values: prices, percentages, IDs, timestamps. ff-num class.

shadows.name: panel-structural
shadows.purpose: ff-box panels. Grounds them in the void without the Material 'lifted card' metaphor.

shadows.name: panel-hover
shadows.purpose: Interactive panel hover state. Indigo aura marks the panel as clickable.

shadows.name: glow-crystal
shadows.purpose: Focus states and active interactive elements.

shadows.name: glow-mako
shadows.purpose: Profit indicators and verified/live data states.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Default for all state changes: color, border, opacity. Short and precise.

motion.name: hover-transition
motion.purpose: Panel hover states. Slightly longer for the spatial glow effect.

motion.name: atb-sweep
motion.purpose: ATB loading bar fill. The system's signature loading animation.

motion.name: shimmer
motion.purpose: Skeleton loading states. Opacity pulse between 0.3 and 0.6.

breakpoints.name: sm
breakpoints.note: Brand text hides; table columns collapse

breakpoints.name: lg
breakpoints.note: Tertiary table columns appear; full desktop layout

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Confirmed action. Gold border and text signal consequence. Use for the single primary action on a screen.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font-family: 'Cinzel', Georgia, serif; font-size: 0.7rem; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; background: linear-gradient(160deg, #141440 0%, #1e1e60 100%); border: 1px solid #f0c030; color: #f0c030; padding: 0.55rem 1.5rem; cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; white-space: nowrap; border-radius: 0; transition: background 120ms ease-out, box-shadow 120ms ease-out, color 120ms ease-out, border-color 120ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover:not(:disabled) { background: linear-gradient(160deg, #1e1e60 0%, #28288a 100%); box-shadow: 0 0 22px rgba(240,192,48,0.25); color: #ffe880; border-color: #ffe880; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid #5599ff; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.35; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action. Used for cancel, empty-state CTAs, and lower-priority actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { font-family: 'Cinzel', Georgia, serif; font-size: 0.65rem; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; background: transparent; border: 1px solid #252560; color: #4a5470; padding: 0.45rem 1rem; cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.4rem; border-radius: 0; transition: border-color 120ms ease-out, color 120ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover:not(:disabled) { border-color: #4040a0; color: #5599ff; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid #5599ff; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-ghost:disabled { opacity: 0.25; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Text input and select. A dark slot cut into the panel. Crystal glow on focus.
components.css: .ds-input { background: rgba(4,4,14,0.95); border: 1px solid #252560; color: #ccd4f0; padding: 0.55rem 0.8rem; font-size: 0.875rem; border-radius: 0; width: 100%; transition: border-color 120ms ease-out, box-shadow 120ms ease-out; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #5599ff; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(85,153,255,0.12), inset 0 0 10px rgba(85,153,255,0.04); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #28304a; }

components.name: Panel (ff-box)
components.description: Primary content container. A page in the Chronicle with corner bracket decorations and deep ambient shadow.
components.html:
◆FILTROS DE ANÁLISE
Content goes here.
components.css: .ds-panel { background: rgba(9,9,24,0.97); border: 1px solid #252560; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(37,37,96,0.5), 0 8px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.7); position: relative; transition: border-color 150ms ease-out, box-shadow 150ms ease-out; } .ds-panel::before, .ds-panel::after { content: ''; position: absolute; width: 10px; height: 10px; border-color: #4040a0; border-style: solid; pointer-events: none; z-index: 1; } .ds-panel::before { top: 4px; left: 4px; border-width: 1px 0 0 1px; } .ds-panel::after { bottom: 4px; right: 4px; border-width: 0 1px 1px 0; } .ds-panel:hover { border-color: #4040a0; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(64,64,160,0.2), 0 0 20px rgba(64,64,160,0.12); } .ds-panel-header { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 1.25rem 1.5rem 1rem; } .ds-panel-marker { color: #4040a0; font-size: 0.55rem; } .ds-panel-label { font-family: 'Cinzel', Georgia, serif; font-size: 0.6rem; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #3a4870; } .ds-panel-body { padding: 0 1.5rem 1.25rem; }

components.name: Badge Profit
components.description: Profit/success badge. Mako green. Share Tech Mono. Used for positive margin values.
components.css: .ds-badge-profit { font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.72rem; color: #00dd77; border: 1px solid rgba(0,221,119,0.3); background: rgba(0,50,25,0.4); padding: 0.1rem 0.45rem; border-radius: 0; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Badge Loss
components.description: Loss/danger badge. Phoenix Fire red. Used for negative margin values and errors.
components.css: .ds-badge-loss { font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.72rem; color: #ff5533; border: 1px solid rgba(255,85,51,0.3); background: rgba(50,15,5,0.4); padding: 0.1rem 0.45rem; border-radius: 0; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: ATB Loading Bar
components.description: Active Time Battle loading gauge. The system's signature async feedback pattern. Never substitute with a spinner.
components.css: @keyframes ds-atb-sweep { 0% { width: 0%; opacity: 1; } 85% { width: 95%; opacity: 1; } 100% { width: 100%; opacity: 0.5; } } .ds-atb-track { width: 100%; height: 3px; background: rgba(37,37,96,0.6); overflow: hidden; } .ds-atb-fill { height: 100%; background: linear-gradient(90deg, #5599ff 0%, #00dd77 60%, #f0c030 100%); box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(85,153,255,0.7); animation: ds-atb-sweep 1.8s ease-in-out infinite; }

components.name: Navigation
components.description: Sticky top nav. Cinzel labels, crystal active state, dim default, blur backdrop.
components.html: ItensCraftHistórico
components.css: .ds-nav { background: rgba(5,5,13,0.97); border-bottom: 1px solid #252560; box-shadow: 0 1px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.6); backdrop-filter: blur(14px); display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 20px; padding: 0 24px; height: 3rem; } .ds-nav-link { font-family: 'Cinzel', Georgia, serif; font-size: 0.62rem; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #4a5470; text-decoration: none; position: relative; padding-bottom: 1px; transition: color 120ms ease-out; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: #9aa8c8; } .ds-nav-link--active { color: #5599ff; text-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(85,153,255,0.5); } .ds-nav-link--active::after { content: ''; position: absolute; bottom: -1px; left: 0; right: 0; height: 1px; background: #5599ff; box-shadow: 0 0 6px rgba(85,153,255,0.8); }

narrative.overview:
The Crystal Chronicle does not embellish. It records. Every screen in this system is a page in an ancient tome that has been keeping the truth since the Age of Ancients: prices, margins, profit, loss. The typography is Cinzel because this information is inscribed, not typed. The background is near-black void because the crystals need darkness to glow. Crystal blue marks what is alive and interactive; Gil Gold marks what is primary and consequential; Mako Green marks what is profitable and alive.

The design is ceremonious and precise. A button press carries the weight of confirming a battle action. Nothing is rounded because softness would undermine the gravity of market data. Every interaction is deliberate: crystal glow on focus, gold shimmer on primary actions, the ATB bar when the system is thinking.

This system explicitly rejects: the generic SaaS dashboard; the gamer RGB aesthetic; and mobile-first layouts that sacrifice data density for appearance of cleanliness.
keyCharacteristics: Zero border-radius: every surface is angular, deliberate, a page or panel
Semantic color system: crystal (interactive), mako (profit), fire (loss), gold (primary action), materia (rare)
Two typefaces only: Cinzel for headings/labels, Share Tech Mono for numbers
Structural shadow (ff-box depth) + status glow serve distinct roles and must never be conflated
ATB loading bar as the system's signature feedback pattern

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Each accent color has one job. Crystal is interactive. Mako is profit. Fire is danger. Gold is primary action. Materia is rare. These roles never overlap.

rules.name: The Gradient Exception
rules.body: The ff-title class uses gradient text for the brand mark only. All other text uses a single solid color.

rules.name: The Two Voice Rule
rules.body: Cinzel and Share Tech Mono are the only expressive typefaces. Figtree handles body prose. Never introduce a third display typeface.

rules.name: The Mono Rule
rules.body: Every number is Share Tech Mono. This is a data-integrity signal. Monospaced numbers align in columns and mark 'this is a value, not a name.'

rules.name: The Flat-at-Rest Rule
rules.body: Elements are flat by default. Shadows appear only on ff-box panels (structural) and interactive elements in active state (glow).

rules.name: The Two Shadow Roles Rule
rules.body: Structural shadows (ambient black) establish planes. Glow shadows (colored) communicate state. Never conflate them.

dos: Do use border-radius: 0 on every interactive element: buttons, inputs, panels, badges.
Do use Share Tech Mono for every numeric value: prices, percentages, item counts, timestamps, IDs.
Do use the ATB bar for every async loading state. Spinners break the vocabulary.
Do use semantic accent colors exclusively in their assigned roles.
Do place the crystal glow on focus-visible states across all interactive elements.
Do prefix every ff-label section header with a ◆ or ✦ decorative marker in indigo-hi.
Do include prefers-reduced-motion overrides when adding any new animation.
donts: Don't use border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a colored accent stripe on cards or callouts.
Don't use background-clip: text with a gradient on anything except the primary brand ff-title class.
Don't use glassmorphism decoratively. The nav's backdrop-filter is the single justified exception.
Don't build a hero-metric template: big number, small label, gradient accent, supporting stats.
Don't build identical card grids (same-sized cards, icon + heading + text repeated).
Don't introduce a third display typeface. Cinzel, Share Tech Mono, and Figtree are the complete vocabulary.
Don't use neon rainbow or RGB effects.
Don't design for mobile-first at the expense of desktop data density.
Don't put body text or data values in Cinzel.
Don't use colored glows as decorative ambient effects on static elements.
